author: kedhareswer
name: FAQ Accordion Section
description: FAQ accordion section set in one ink on one paper: a display headline cut by a stencil slit that lifts clear on hover, live search across questions and answers with matches highlighted, and rows that flood with ink edge to edge as they open. A real accessible accordion with keyboard navigation, deep links per question and Copy link. Single or multiple open, four presets, light and dark.
